sourceText:
Fresh Strawberry Cupcakes
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 26, 2009 - 12:03am

Ingredients




1 3/4 cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
1 cup Sugar
1/2 cup Chopped Walnuts
2 Eggs
1/2 cup Vegetable Oil
1/2 teaspoon Almond or vanilla extract
10 ounces Pkg frzn sweet Strawberries*

Preparation

1 * Or 1 cup crushed fresh strawberries mixed with 3 T sugar Mix together flour, baking soda, sugar and nuts in a bowl. In another bowl, beat together eggs, flavoring and oil until well blended. Add strawberries and beat at slow speed of mixer until berries are partially broken. Beat in flour mixture slowly until smooth, but pieces of berries are still visible. Pour batter into greased muffin tins, filling to half. 2 Bake at 350 deg F for 30 minutes, or until they test done. Or, bake in greased 9x5x3" loaf pan for at 350 deg F for 1 hour, or until done. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired.
